title: Mask composite - blend two image-history entries through a mask (Add / Subtract)
description: New image-history context-menu action, gated like Compare on exactly 2 selected entries where one carries a mask. A dialog offers Add (masked area comes from the OTHER entry, rest stays the masked entry) or Subtract (the inverse: other entry is the base, masked area comes from the masked entry) plus Cancel. Result lands as a new history entry (operation 'composite'), so it is undoable by deleting it. Motivating case: an upscale morphs one of two cats - mask the bad cat, pull the good one back from the previous entry. Compositing is server-side Sharp (already a dependency, same engine crop-media uses) with a feathered mask, so no ComfyUI workflow and no 4K base64 round-trip.
outcome: SHIPPED + USER-VERIFIED live ("working lovely") - composite_001..006 produced across both directions on a real cat/character group. Sharp does the pixels server-side (POST /project/composite-media); no ComfyUI workflow, no canvas round-trip. Mask holes are filled to match MaskDetailerPipe contour_fill, and the mask is feathered (sigma min(w,h)/400, overridable). Two Sharp traps cost a debug cycle each: removeAlpha() before joinChannel silently drops the join, and sharp(raw,{channels:1}) writes back 3 channels - both caught by tests/mask-composite.test.cjs (3/3).
